summary: Repair the verified remaining AlembicPlugin five-tool usability defects found by controller calls against the existing BiliDili and AlembicWorkspace knowledge roots. Reproduce only on isolated copies of the two real roots; never mutate live knowledge during implementation. (1) A plan-confirmed Workspace moduleMining rescan scoped to Alembic/AlembicCore/AlembicPlugin/AlembicDashboard leaked coverage and source evidence into BiliDili and Test/tmp replicas; make rescan/ProjectContext consumption honor the request ProjectScope folder set and confirmed moduleScope, excluding control-root siblings and historical Test/tmp trees. (2) The same rescan classified cleanly inspected Alembic/Core/Dashboard ranges as skipped but left checkpointCommit behind forever while advancing Plugin; advance a folder checkpoint to current HEAD after a successful complete no-op/skipped classification, while preserving failed/truncated/unresolved ranges as stale. Resolve duplicate legacy per-repo versus control-root checkpoint rows deterministically without deleting audit evidence. (3) For BiliDili single-folder, status reports identityAlignment=mismatch while Search/Graph/Recipe Map report current/current over the same root/root row; make public revision truth consistent. (4) Explicit Workspace projectRoot resolves ecf32806 correctly even while selected/active=BiliDili, yet full status degrades businessOk solely for Dashboard handoff mismatch; keep handoff mismatch as diagnostic/launch gating without invalidating explicit pure-local MCP project status. (5) Guard clean output reports appliedRules.total=6 built-ins while separately applying four Recipe rules, and claims every violation has inline recipe although ast_class_bloat violation has none; make rule accounting and fix guidance schema/output honest. Add focused RED/GREEN tests for each case, run check/build/runtime/distribution verification, and return commit plus detached two-root and multi-folder probes. Do not add knowledge, run dimension production, create environments, modify Core unless ownership evidence proves Plugin cannot fix a specific slice, or touch BiliDili/Alembic live source/data.
